1. (Currently amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination,
a. the finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion;
b. the method including the steps of:
i. securing the finger palette to a finger;
ii. __using an applicator instrument to__ depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and
iii. __using the applicator instrument to__ transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity__; and
c. the surface portion is cleaned after transferring the second quantity__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and
b. the surface portion is free, from any first point on the outer perimeter to any second point on the outer perimeter, of features that could trap cosmetics and complicate cleaning of the surface portion__; and
c. the cosmetic product is spread on the surface portion using an applicator instrument__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom__; and wherein the cosmetic product is applied to the destination using an applicator instrument__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar__; and wherein the method further includes the step of blending multiple cosmetic products on the surface portion__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion__; and wherein the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination using an applicator instrument__.
